name: record-scaffolding-merge-limits
body: Two limits. (1) The merged files map is unioned and never pruned against the manifest, so a path deleted in an earlier scan can keep a later-retired module alive until a full-scan extraction replaces the record. (2) A pure-intermediate module with no files entry whose only parent module is retired survives as an orphan module with no parent edge until a full scan re-extracts; upgrade if the retirement walk must cascade through the stored Module-to-Module tree or prune stale file paths.
